content: समालम्ब् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To lay or catch hold of, seize; स्वरूपमास्थाय च तां कृतस्मितः समाललम्बे वृषराजकेतनः <ls>Ku. 5. 84</ls>. .²2 To rest or depend on, be supported by; to cling or adhere to. .²3 To devote or give oneself up to. .²4 To assume, maintain. .²5 To settle down or a bide in.
